status: Provisional ranking among reviewed engineers; evidence review is selective.

methodology.formula: Sum of the three strongest reviewed initiative scores; each = outcome (0–4) + reach (0–3). Maximum 21.
methodology.ties: Equal scores share ranks. Five featured places prioritize inspected evidence grade and then supported reach; cutoff alternatives remain disclosed.
methodology.limitations: All 193 identified human authors screened. Selective assessment covers 57 PRs from 25 authors. This subset was reconstructed after submission from the original 46 plus 11 previously assessed PRs, prioritizing under-reviewed authors and inspected support. It is not the original submitted analysis. Descriptions and selected implementation/regression excerpts were inspected; tests and benchmarks were not independently run.
methodology.evidence: Relevant diff excerpts inspected; tests and benchmarks not independently executed.
methodology.confidence: Reported measurements are labeled separately; scores are analyst judgments, not measured business impact.

screening.method: Every author screened; binary outcome/evidence terms; top-three cap; two candidates per area; five area nominations then fill to at least 15 retaining cutoff ties. Current leading positions retained for equal re-review. Hash-based ordering schedules review, not impact.

selection_policy.order: Score, then sum of inspected evidence grades, then supported reach across counted initiatives.
selection_policy.evidence_grades: 2: implementation and regression excerpts; 1: implementation/configuration only; 0: guidance only. Tests were not executed. These grades describe inspected support, not certainty of business impact.
selection_policy.ties: Scores retain equal ranks. Cutoff alternatives are disclosed; feature selection expresses a stated evidence/reach preference, not a unique mathematical winner.

sensitivity.limitation: Only tests weights within reviewed evidence; does not correct selection or review-depth bias.
